title: Planet Fitness Creator Partnership 2026: How Influencers Actually Get In
excerpt: Planet Fitness does run creator partnerships in 2026, but there is no public application form. Here is how the brand works with influencers, who to contact, and what content they actually use.
content:
Planet Fitness Creator / Influencer Partnership in 2026

Creators search for a Planet Fitness influencer application every week. There is not a public creator form on planetfitness.com. The gym still works with influencers — tracking sites listed dozens of sponsored Planet Fitness posts as of June 2026 — but the route in is outreach, not a signup page.

This page is the honest version: what Planet Fitness is running in 2026, who actually books creators, and how a small fitness creator should pitch without inventing a programme that does not exist. For other gym and supplement brands that do have open forms, use our fitness PR list.

Gym-chain partnerships are slow. A personalised pitch with your media kit attached is still how most fitness creators get a yes. Newcollab writes the email and attaches your kit.

Start pitching brands free →

Does Planet Fitness work with creators?

Yes. Planet Fitness has used influencer and social-first campaigns for years, including the 2026 “Planet Hype Up” work with Flavor Flav, produced by the social agency Movers+Shakers. That campaign ran on TikTok and Instagram and was built around real members, not polished gym ads.

That is brand-side creative, not an open ambassador list. Independent tracking (Modash, June 2026) still shows creators posting sponsored Planet Fitness content. The brand buys creator posts. It does not publish a public “apply to be a Planet Fitness influencer” portal.

There is no public creator application

Do not waste a week hunting for a hidden form. The official Planet Fitness site has a PF Media Network page, and that is for advertisers who want to buy club and digital media against members. It is not a creator gifting programme.

If a landing page promises “Planet Fitness PR packages for 1K followers,” treat it as a guess. This page will not invent a follower floor the brand has not published.

How creators actually get a Planet Fitness partnership

  1. Pitch the social agency, not info@. Movers+Shakers has booked Planet Fitness social work. A short email to their influencer / social team with a gym-member story, your local club, and a 15-second sample is more useful than a generic “I love PF” DM.
  2. Start at your club. Franchise locations run local member events. Ask the club manager who handles community / social. Local UGC they can reshare is easier to say yes to than a national ambassador ask.
  3. Make judgement-free gym content they can actually post. Planet Fitness’s line is the Judgement Free Zone. Workout-beginner, GLP-1, “I showed up” content fits better than bodybuilding flex videos they will never run.
  4. Do not confuse media-network ads with a gifted membership. PF Media Network is an ad product for other brands. Creators should not apply there expecting a free Black Card.

What to put in the pitch

Keep it under 150 words. Attach your kit. Name the club. Propose one piece of content, not a six-month ambassadorship.

Subject: Local Planet Fitness member content — [City] club

Hi [Name],
I train at the [city] Planet Fitness. I make judgement-free gym content for people who are new to working out.
Here is a 15-second sample: [link]
Kit attached. Happy to film one member-first Reel your club can reshare. No usage grab.
[Name] · [handle] · [city]

If you need a brand with an open form

Planet Fitness is a slow, closed door. Plenty of fitness brands still take micro-influencer applications. Start with Alphalete, Gymreapers, Hydro Jug, and the rest of the 30+ fitness PR list. Newcollab drafts the pitch and attaches your kit so you are not filling dead forms all week.

FAQ

Does Planet Fitness have a creator influencer partnership programme in 2026?

They run creator and celebrity social campaigns, including 2026 work with Flavor Flav via Movers+Shakers. There is no public application form for independent creators.

How do I apply to be a Planet Fitness influencer?

You do not apply on a branded form. Pitch the club manager, or the social agency that books their content, with a local member story and a kit. PF Media Network is for advertisers, not creators.

Does Planet Fitness send PR packages to small creators?

They have paid sponsored posts with creators. They have not published a gifting / PR list with follower minimums. Do not treat a third-party “PR list” as official.
